Verified as Lighter (lighter.xyz), Ethereum ZK-rollup perpetual-futures DEX founded 2022 by Vladimir Novakovski; input lists Miami. The SPC source anchor is #lunchclub: per Fortune, Novakovski pivoted Lunchclub (AI professional-networking startup, founded 2017 with Scott Wu and Hayley Leibson) into Lighter, keeping ~80% of the team. Lunchclub rounds: $4M seed led by a16z (Sep 2019, TechCrunch) and a $24.2M Series A led by Coatue and Lightspeed at a >$100M valuation (2020, CNBC). As Lighter: a previously unreported $21M round in 2024 led by Haun Ventures and Craft Ventures, and $68M in Nov 2025 led by Founders Fund and Ribbit (~$1.5B valuation per sources; mix of equity and LIT token warrants). Neither Lighter-era round has a public stage label, so 'round' is left blank; status seed+ rests on the Lunchclub-era priced Series A (assumes same corporate entity, which Fortune implies but does not state). amount_raised = sum of the four sourced rounds ($117.2M); Fortune puts Lighter-era funding at almost $90M and Lunchclub-era at ~$30M. Excludes LIT token (launched Dec 2025).
